evals.name: change-reconciliation-machinery
evals.prompt: I need to change how the orchestrator reconciles dispatched runs when a session resumes after a provider handoff. Before I start, where do I read up on how dispatch, reconciliation and auto-merge actually work under the hood today in the fleet control-plane repo?
evals.expected_output: Points to the control-plane summary (lcars-protocol.md) and the deeper lcars-protocol-reference.md for dispatch/reconciliation/session-resume internals, and notes that worker behavior lives separately in agent-protocol.
assertions: Names lcars-protocol.md as the control-plane summary and lcars-protocol-reference.md as the implementation reference for dispatch, reconciliation and session-resume
States that fleet worker behavior lives in agent-protocol and general dev guardrails in agent-lcars-dev, not in this reference
Notes the reference is situational and not a mandatory dispatch document

evals.name: how-does-auto-merge-work
evals.prompt: Can you explain how the fleet control plane decides to auto-merge a bot PR and how provider telemetry feeds into that? I'm trying to understand the current machinery, not do a dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Explains this is a control-plane question answered by the LCARS protocol summary and reference documents, and distinguishes it from the worker protocol a dispatched agent follows.
assertions: Directs to the LCARS control-plane documents (lcars-protocol.md / lcars-protocol-reference.md) as the source for auto-merge and telemetry machinery
Distinguishes the control-plane implementation reference from the agent-protocol a dispatched worker follows
Does not treat the request as a dispatched task or impose dispatch obligations
